summary: Smith+Nephew plc filed a Form 6-K on May 6, 2026, announcing a new $500 million share buyback program alongside its Q1 2026 trading update. The buyback reflects management's confidence in 2026 performance, strong balance sheet, and free cash flow generation. The filing also noted Q1 revenue of $1,501 million, underlying growth of 3.1%, and an unchanged full-year outlook targeting ~6% revenue growth and ~$800 million free cash flow. No board recommendation or advisor was named. The buyback is a capital-return event, not a tender offer or strategic review. Watch for execution pace and impact on EPS.
